about: The one identity record for detoxdenver.org. lib/seo.ts builds every Organization node (layout, blog Article author) from this file, and scripts/authority/entity_backlink_watch.mjs checks every sameAs profile weekly (.github/workflows/entity-backlink-watch.yml). Only real, live profiles of this business go in sameAs; a profile that is planned but not live yet goes in profiles_pending and is promoted by the watch once it resolves. Never a profile of another business.
name: Dianne's Place Recovery Services

sameAs_notes.https://www.diannesplacerecoveryservices: The business's own Webador site (site_identity.json sisterSite). Owner, 1 Nov 2026: links between the two sites are fine; each keeps its own canonicals. It is a sameAs, never a canonical, hreflang or sitemap target.
